reviews.comment: Ben is an amazing professor. be ready to put the work in because he does move very quickly compared to other professors(no sleep) but he will take SO much time out of his schedule to help you no matter what. He is really nice but pushes you to come to your own conclusions. IMO he will give you the most experience possible compared to other profs
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Baaske was an incredible professor. I took both 105 & 108 summer studios with him. He cares about students and is willing to help at all times. Never in a bad mood and is not afraid to give feedback and help improve your thought process. Definitely would like to take again.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Prof. Baaske is super chill. He is very helpful and gives great feedback on the projects. If you are struggling he will take time out of his day to help get you back to speed. 10/10 would take again.

He was very understanding of situations that happened outside of school and didn't mind giving extra time as long as you did your work well. The only thing I wish he did better on was providing feedback since he normally is too cautious about criticizing anyone. He was the best person to have as a first-semester student who was struggling.

Really great professor and is really understanding of absences. Not everyone has the resources to get a doctors note, or can explain the amount of academic stress their under. My only flaw is that he gives bland feedback on studio work and could stand to be more strict and informative of what the specific grading criteria should be.

ok so the department had ben teaching multiple levels of studio and so for the first half of the semester we didn't really see him or have much of a relationship with him. this made getting crits and feedback super hard and our section was just kinda winging it BUT by the end, he seemed to really really care about us and is super helpful.
